product.name: Bunbird
product.shortDescription: Build and publish small web apps
product.packageDescription: Build small web apps with an AI agent, preview them live, and publish them in your Bunbird organisation, through one hosted MCP server.
product.longDescription: Bunbird is an agent-first platform for small web apps made for a group of people, with sign-in, data, files, live updates and background work provided by the platform. An agent reads the author's guide, builds a draft in one of the person's organisations, shows a live preview, and publishes it there. This package connects your agent to Bunbird's hosted MCP server; the server itself carries the guide and the flow.
product.skillDescription: Build, preview and publish small web apps with Bunbird, a hosted platform driven through its MCP server (bunbird). Use when the person wants an app, tool, tracker or form built and hosted, or mentions Bunbird.
product.ruleDescription: Build, preview and publish a small hosted web app with Bunbird. Use when the person wants an app, tool, tracker or form that outlives the chat.

server.name: bunbird
server.summary: Every tool works for the signed-in person: the author's guide, drafts in their organisations, previews and publishing.

defaultPrompts: Build me a small web app with Bunbird.
